references.text: Fire from the altar was holy and authorized by God, unlike foreign fire that led to judgment against Nadab and Abihu.
Aaron used the censer with fire from the altar and incense on the Day of Atonement to make atonement.
The Levites were to prevent God's wrath from coming upon the congregation of Israel.
The Levites were given to make atonement for the Israelites and prevent plagues.
The Lord's anger burned against the people, and He struck them with a great plague.
Phinehas stopped the plague by acting quickly to make atonement for the Israelites.
The incense was to be burned on the altar of incense as part of the daily service.
The warning that God's wrath could break out against the entire congregation.
David built an altar and offered sacrifices to stop the plague that struck Israel.
Christ always lives to intercede for those who come to God through Him, just as Aaron interceded for the people.
